ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with discrete high-intensity (white) pixel clusters making up the remaining 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid black contiguous field. High-contrast white mottling and geometric blobs are concentrated along the central vertical axis (near the notch) and the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, randomized white pixel clusters are distributed across the medial lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees; the notch apex exhibits a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe connection points.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks and valleys) are most pronounced on the outer two-thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending upward and outward from the median notch, maintaining a consistent upward sweep until reaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups localized on the extreme distal tips (left and right) and concentrated around the central notch region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal white linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible; specifically, three parallel linear marks are detectable on the inner-right lobe, and several fainter diagonal marks are present on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular topographical texture on the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with high-density barnacle colonization sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique symmetrical splash-pattern of white pigmentation radiating approximately 20% of the lobe height upward from the median notch.
